Build's clean: 0 errors, exit code 0. The 8 remaining warnings are just deprecation noise (Buffer(), punycode, etc.) — not blockers.

Fixed 2 real bugs, both from the bundler's options-shape change (`retries` → `retryCount`):
1. `src/core/options.js:6` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries` (now undefined), crashed on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — `isBackoffEnabled` treated unset flags as invalid instead of `false`, since the new loader returns `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

Next: run your test suite to confirm nothing else depends on the old `retries`/`false` behavior elsewhere.
